objective.value: Teach that before writing, the first archive was a living body — and everything it kept died with it, uncopied.
objective.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 1, 2026-10-26) — derived from the piece's purpose (Earth One Ep.1 opens the Planet's Story: it must install the series' first idea — information had homes before writing, and the first home was alive and mortal) and reconciled against the catalogue objective of record, not copied from it
objective.rationale: The catalogue objective of record reads: 'Show that before writing, information lived inside living bodies, carried in patterns and learned behaviour' (objectives audit, GROUNDED in the locked script's T-17). This branch's objective is the same viewer change stated as this build's success condition, with the piece's turn inside it: the viewer arrives assuming information needs things humans make (books, stones, screens — misconception S-01) and must leave able to say the first archive was a living body AND that what it kept died with it uncopied. The sting is inside the objective because the sting is what the series runs on: every later episode exists because this archive could die. 20 words (the scaffold's 5–20 band).
objective.record: catalogue objectives audit (hidden_files/objectives-2026-10-24/catalogue-objectives.md — Ep.1 rows, GROUNDED); locked script doc T-17 (files/short-eo01-i7-script.md) as corroboration, consulted as evidence

message.value: Before writing, information lived in living bodies, in two ways: in the body itself — a pattern like a spotted coat, copied into the young — and in behaviour — what the young learned by watching. If it was not passed on, it died with the body. (Essence: 'Life stored information in bodies first.')
message.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 1, 2026-10-26), re-derived from the phase-1 objective: the message must carry the two channels (the objective's 'everything it kept' is only sayable once the two keepings are named) and the mortality clause (the objective's second half)
message.rationale: The wording descends from the piece's own T-17 learning sentence — adopted because the derivation re-checks out from the objective directly (two keepings + one mortality = the objective's two halves), not because an earlier script carried it. One wording change from the record's T-17, made here and owned: 'in two ways' moves up front (the pair is the piece's map; the viewer should hold it before the proofs), and 'it was lost' becomes 'it died with the body' — 'lost' is passive and vague; the piece's villain is death, and the message names it.
message.record: the phase-1 objective (this file); the record's T-17 cited as evidence in transcript/consolidation.md (phase 3)

audience.value: The Earth One lane-standard audience: a general cold viewer addressed at high-school plain language. The misconception the piece corrects (S-01): 'information needs writing / records are human-made.'
audience.source: lane record (files/earthone-format.md + files/earthone-series-slate-2026-10-23.md — the governing citations both script docs carry); board record phase-0 check 'Audience + misconception named' PASS on retro-QC evidence
audience.rationale: Required by the objective, not inferred from an artifact: the hook only lands on a viewer who assumes records are things people make. The lane fixes the reading level (high-school plain language; jargon only as one deliberate push — this piece's push is the word 'archive', cashed out in plain words inside the piece). Earth One's design-viewer discipline applies as the lane states it: a cold viewer, no Academy knowledge presumed; every name glossed in the same breath at first mention.

role.value: Earth One Episode 1 — the INTRODUCE step of the Planet's Story (playlist 'The Planet's Story — Observations', Earth One channel): the opener of the information-evolution arc every later episode continues. It installs the series' premise (information has homes; the first was alive) and its engine (that home could die), and its ending routes the viewer onward to Ep.2.
role.source: lane record (series slate: Ep.1 is the batch's control and the arc's first chapter; STRUCT-2 H5 = D 'INTRODUCE (series premise)' on both old entries); the phase-1 objective
role.rationale: The role is fixed by the arc, not by the old build: Ep.2 (the story as the first backup) only makes sense as the answer to this episode's fatal rule, so this piece must end holding an open door, not a closed moral — which is why the ending's form (field end_referral) is a role-level decision, taken in this phase under the owner's ENDING STANDARD.

story_structure.value: Five moves, prescribed from the objective: M1 THE OPEN QUESTION (writing's youth stated; the question asked; the invite; the think beat — the world holds its breath) → M2 THE ANSWER IS A BODY (the claim lands on living bodies: three generations standing in a line — the archive shown before it is analysed) → M3 TWO DOORS (the pair declared, then proved one door at a time: the coat that hides from the lion, performed; the route to water, drawn and followed) → M4 THE FATAL RULE (scale first — copy after copy for millions of years — then the turn: die uncopied and everything dies with you; the sting stands alone) → M5 EPITAPH + THE DOOR OUT (the plain statement; the bookend: the first archive was a living body; then the spoken carry — the next home named, the Academy plugged in the piece's own terms). Spine: And–But–Therefore, re-derived below.
story_structure.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26) from the phase-1 objective + the lane's structure law (series slate: one message per short, ABT declared before drafting as the lane's gate discipline)
story_structure.rationale: The ABT spine survives re-derivation because the objective is ABT-shaped: a state of affairs (AND: two keepings), a fatal flaw in it (BUT: both die uncopied), and the conclusion the flaw forces (THEREFORE: the first archive was a body — and had to stop being the only one). What does NOT survive is the old succession's grain: the old build declared the pair, proved both, compressed, scaled, turned — eleven beats in a row of states. This prescription reorganises around the answer's-arrival (M2 shows the archive as a population BEFORE the analysis starts, so both proofs read as doors into a place the viewer has already seen) and gives the ending a second job (M5's door out) that the old structure never had: its bridge was an ask stapled after the close; here the carry is a move inside the architecture, motivated by the sting itself ('no backup' is exactly what the next home fixes). Narrative architecture, designed here and audited at phase 3: OPENING PROMISE — the question + the empty dawn world promise an answer that is a place, not a thing; JOINTS — every transition carries a stated reason (phase 3's architecture map prices them one by one); ARC — QUESTION → BODY → TWO DOORS → DOORS CLOSING → EPITAPH → DOOR OUT (a descent from wonder to mortality, then one step upward: the door); RECALL — three devices: the dawn world returns at the epitaph (finale plate: the opening light, now with the herd on the horizon); the word 'backup' planted negated at the sting returns affirmed as the next chapter's name ('the first backup'); the title itself ('The First Archive Was a Body', on the opening card) is paid by the epitaph line.
story_structure.record: this phase's prescription; audited joint-by-joint in transcript/consolidation.md (phase 3)

hook_form.value: Question opening — the prediction hook, WITH its suspension built into the architecture (the #54 repair as a structural member, not a patch): L1 states writing's youth as a striking number and asks where information lived before it; L2 is the invite (a delivery-role line, the owner's own example phrase from his #54 feedback); then the F3 think beat (1,500 ms) runs with the question visibly open on screen — the empty dawn world holds, no animal yet, the question's words stay lit — before L3 answers. The expected completions (caves, memory, stories) are all wrong; the payoff reframes the question.
hook_form.source: the owner's Action #54 finding + his example phrase (2026-10-25); pause doctrine §3 (the question rule: suspension device + a visual that stays open + the answer inside ~2 s of voice-time after the beat); the lane record (slate: Ep.1 is the batch's control — question hook is its named device)
hook_form.rationale: Silence alone after L1 was weighed and rejected as the sole device (the v5 editor record's reasoning stands up: in the first five seconds, pure dead air spends the riskiest window on nothing; the invite converts the suspension into participation — the viewer is asked to guess, so the silence reads as their turn). The owner's suggested countdown was likewise rejected there (a children's-TV register this series does not use). What this phase adds to the v5 record: the suspension is now load-bearing in the STRUCTURE (M1 is built around it — the scene's first world-state is 'the question, held'), so no future delivery pass can flatten it without breaking the architecture, which is how the flat-gap defect (D5) happened last time.

style_direction.value: RECORDED EXPERIMENT — THE ILLUSTRATED WORLD, PERFORMED. Spine: Earth One's own picture-book world (format v4): full-bleed painted plates as the stage, independent cutout objects over them, hand-lettered word animation in each scene's planned negative space. The variable under test: PERFORMED TRANSFORMATIONS inside held plates — the coat's copy arrives as a new body in the grass; the route to water DRAWS ITSELF across the plate and is followed; at the fatal rule the light dies and the still body replaces the standing world; the dawn returns for the epitaph. NOT the A59 typographic void (soa-01 / wd-01 / wd-02's grammar — a definitional-lane stage; Earth One's identity is a place, and this piece's proofs are animals, not terms), and NOT whiteboard construction (ws01-v2 is already testing the blueprint register on the flagship lane; a construction register would fight this story's deep-time warmth). Delivery half of the experiment: storyteller cadence — the suspension is scenic (the world holds its breath with the question open), line transitions at the warm end of the doctrine's ranges. HYPOTHESIS: for a story-lane episode, attention rides on a world that changes in place; if the performed transformations hold the viewer better than plate succession did (the old build's H7 weakness), the lane gains its default visual mode for the next batch (the slate's own comparison plan names this unknown).
style_direction.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26): the lane's format law (files/earthone-format.md v4 — plate + stickers + word animation) weighed against the sibling rebuilds' recorded treatments (soa-01: A59 cinematic typography; wd-01/wd-02: A59 spine; ws01-v2: 2D graphics + whiteboard blueprint) under the owner's style-experimentation directive (2026-10-26: vary deliberately, as recorded experiments)
style_direction.rationale: Two constraints bound the experiment from the record, not from taste: (1) the art itself is the piece's own generated artwork (the v3 generation's plates and cutouts) — raw material consulted as evidence; several plates carry generation damage (the figure plate's centre is smeared; the dusk plate's foreground band is shattered), so the prescription routes around the damage (the figure beat is re-cast onto the generational row plate; the dusk beat zooms past the damaged band) and the scene design answers for every plate it uses, by eye, at phase 4. (2) Word animation is the only text motion: no caption band exists anywhere in the design (defect D1 is answered by construction at phase 4, and the absence is verified on the rendered frames at phase 7).
style_direction.record: files/earthone-format.md (v3 word-animation law + v4 HTML-scene law); files/a59-motion-brief.md (the siblings' grammar, weighed); sibling phase-2 records (hidden_files/rebuild-wd01, rebuild-dir)

delivery_structure.value: Storyteller cadence over the five moves: the suspension architecture is structural (M1's invite + F3 think beat; suspense priced before the turn; the sting isolated on its own breath; consolidation after the peak), transitions are guideposts at the joints where the thought changes kind, and every inter-line gap is priced by function from the pause doctrine's classes at phase 3 — no flat gaps anywhere (defect D5 is the anti-pattern). Intonation intent is recorded per line at phase 3 and binds the synthesis. The music bed is one continuous, level-locked track under the whole piece (lane constants, files/earthone-format.md §Music bed); pauses live in the narration only.
delivery_structure.source: pause doctrine (files/pause-transition-doctrine.md §1–§4 — every pause a recorded decision, priced by function); lane format (bed constants + the level rule)
delivery_structure.rationale: The pattern is decided here; the map itself (each joint's size + basis) is phase 3's delivery.md, and the delivered gaps are measured against it at phase 7 (doctrine §7: >150 ms off the map is a build defect).
delivery_structure.record: Route: transcript/delivery.md (phase 3) for the priced map

end_referral.value: A SPOKEN CARRY inside the architecture (M5's second half), in two short lines after the epitaph: (1) the next home named — the story told out loud, 'the first backup' — which is Ep.2's subject and title concept, so the referral lands on a named, existing next thing; (2) the Academy plug in the piece's own terms — the story of where information lives is the story Hadosh Academy tells, and its newest home is the one you build and own yourself. Then the end card (finale world held): 'NEXT — THE STORY WAS THE FIRST BACKUP' + 'EARTH ONE'. The banned formula appears nowhere — not spoken, not on the card, and (packaging note for the future upload) not in any description this branch would ship.
end_referral.source: the owner's ENDING STANDARD (2026-10-26: the ending must CARRY — invite onward to a named next thing AND plug Hadosh Academy in the piece's own terms; a silent bridge card alone does not satisfy it) — this is the standard the wd-01 rebuild failed at 58, applied here from the architecture up
end_referral.rationale: The old build's bridge failed the standard three ways: it was silent in effect (an ask stapled after the close), it named no next thing (only 'the rest of the story'), and it spoke the banned formula. The v5 development's bridge fixed the wording but kept the shape (one line, no Academy, series-only). This form answers the standard directly: the carry is motivated by the sting (the next home is the fix for 'no backup' — the recall device and the referral are the same words), the next thing is named by its title concept, and the Academy enters through the piece's own subject — homes of information — not through an imported slogan. Navigation share is priced at phase 3 and recorded against the doctrine's budget with the standard conflict named (the owner's 2026-10-26 ending standard outranks the 2025 doctrine target; the 20% hard cap is respected). Wording is settled at phase 3.

scene_decomposition.value: ONE self-contained HTML file (the MP4 renders from this file alone), in six compartments: C0 THE WORLD — the plate layer (eight painted plates, cover-cropped, slow push-in per the lane's dialect; damaged regions routed out of frame by the crop/zoom choices recorded per plate); C1 THE ACTORS — independent cutout objects (the lion, the young antelope, the still body, trees) entering, exiting and transforming over the plates; C2 THE TRANSFORMATIONS — the performed layer (the copy arriving in the grass; the route drawing itself as a dotted line and being followed; the light dying at the fatal rule; motion itself halting at the sting); C3 THE WORDS — word animation per line in the scene's planned negative space (hand lettering; ≤3 words on screen; the key word carries the pop) — the ONLY narration text in the piece: there is no caption band, no plate element, nothing at the bottom of the frame that carries text across lines; C4 THE LABELS — one hand-lettered scene label per beat, in negative space (titles, not narration text); C5 THE CARDS + BUG — opening card (dawn plate + EARTH ONE + the title), end card (finale held + NEXT tease + EARTH ONE), the small EARTH ONE bug top-left inside the safe rect. An editor layer rides the file (click an element, adjust, copy the overrides out) — the package's editability proof at phase 7.
scene_decomposition.source: format v4 (files/earthone-format.md — the HTML-scene law: plate as canvas, components over it, words in planned negative space, context in the file) + this phase's style experiment
scene_decomposition.rationale: Compartments are prescribed here; the element-by-element embodiment (every element with its home, timing and reason) lands at phase 4 in scene/scene.json, and the per-word decisions at phase 5 — generated from the scene's own plan so the record and the shipped file cannot drift.
